status: For reference. Confirm with AMR before machining. Null means not determinable from the CAD.

source.cad: Rosie 1400 robot STEP (rosie-1430-clean.step, Autodesk Fusion export 2026-09-26)
source.method: Interface solids extracted unchanged from the B-rep and moved into the interface frames. Dimensions measured from their faces with Open CASCADE.

base.name: Robot base (floor or pedestal mounting)

frame.name: base
frame.origin: Centre of the base-plate underside (the mounting face), on the J1 axis
frame.x: Robot forward: the direction of the J2 offset with J1 at zero
frame.note: Axes are parallel to the robot CAD frame; the origin is the robot CAD origin moved down to the mounting face.
frame.urdf: Orientation and XY origin match the J1 joint frame (link_1 origin at J1 = 0) of RosieOS robot_description rosie_1400_v3. That URDF is a simplified model; take heights from this file.

plate.thickness_note: Thickness at the plate edges and at the anchor holes. The robot's own seat features stand above it inside the anchor pattern and are not part of the mounting interface.

mounting_face.description: Flat underside, no spigot or dowel holes. The robot's own fasteners are recessed into it.

mounting_holes.note: Plain Ø26 through holes. Ø26 is the ISO 273 medium clearance for M24; confirm anchor size, grade and preload with AMR.

locating_features.note: The CAD has no floor-side spigot or dowel holes. The plate is located by the anchor pattern. Confirm the locating method with AMR if repeatable re-mounting is needed.

base.robot_side_features: Not part of the mounting interface: the holes and recesses inside the anchor pattern take the robot's own fasteners. Their geometry is in the STEP file.
verify: Anchor bolt size, grade and tightening torque
Locating method for repeatable re-mounting (no dowels in the CAD)

tool_flange.name: Tool flange (J6 output, end-of-arm mounting)
tool_flange.part: HSS-17-100-I-D8 hollow-shaft unit, LSS-17 output (bought-in reducer unit)

frame.name: tool_flange
frame.origin: Centre of the flange face, on the J6 axis
frame.z: Out of the flange face, along the J6 axis
frame.x: Midway between two mounting holes: the first mounting hole is 30 deg from +X
frame.clock_note: At the CAD home pose, +X is rotated 3 deg about Z from straight down. Confirm the hole-pattern angle at J6 = 0 on the robot with AMR.
frame.urdf: In RosieOS rosie_1400_v3, tool0 is the torch contact-tip frame, not this flange. The link_6 origin lies on the J6 axis at the flange face with +Z pointing into the wrist, so this frame's Z is link_6 -Z.

mounting_face.note: Flat Ø38 face, 0.5 mm proud of the surrounding shoulder, with a 0.4 x 45 deg edge chamfer. No fit is given; it is not a register.

mounting_holes.thread_source: AMR (the CAD models the Ø4.2 tap-drill bore)
mounting_holes.note: Tapped through the 12.5 mm output plate, with 0.4 mm chamfers at both ends, leaving 11.7 mm of thread. Screws must not protrude past the plate: it opens into the reducer unit.

envelope.note: Largest diameter of the flange unit (its Ø79 mounting flange) and its length from the flange face to its rear face.

tool_flange.other_face_features: Not part of the published tool interface: the face also carries 6 x Ø4.2 holes on PCD 19, 3 x Ø3 holes on PCD 15 and a Ø10 bore. Their geometry is in the STEP file.
tool_flange.iso_9409_1_note: Not an ISO 9409-1 flange: PCD 27 is not an ISO 9409-1 pitch circle. Tooling on the ISO adapter is quoted separately.
